concerns.text: FR-005 wording is contradictory: “averaging the absolute correlation values across all ROI pairs, preserving sign.” Averaging absolute values removes sign, so “preserving sign” cannot hold. Clarify whether the metric should be the mean of raw correlations (preserving sign) or the mean of absolute correlations (ignoring sign).

SC-002 requires re‑running the permutation test with different random seeds to assess p‑value stability, but no functional requirement specifies that the permutation test implementation must accept a user‑controlled random seed. Add a requirement (e.g., FR-016) that the test module must allow explicit seed specification.
